# SSLP data

The `.mps` and `.smps` files in this directory are based on the
[SSLP benchmark instances from SIPLIB](https://www2.isye.gatech.edu/~sahmed/siplib/sslp/sslp.html),
contributed by Lewis Ntaimo and Suvrajeet Sen. The `.mps` files provide MPS
representations used by Tran2SP. The `.smps` files list the corresponding CORE,
TIME, and STOCH filenames.

When reusing these data, please cite the following sources.

- Ahmed, S., Garcia, R., Kong, N., Ntaimo, L., Parija, G., Qiu, F., and Sen, S. (2015).
  [SIPLIB: A Stochastic Integer Programming Test Problem Library](https://www2.isye.gatech.edu/~sahmed/siplib/).
- Ntaimo, L., and Sen, S. (2005).
  [The Million-Variable "March" for Stochastic Combinatorial Optimization](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10898-004-5910-6).
  *Journal of Global Optimization*, 32, 385-400.

No separate data license file is included in the official SIPLIB SSLP archive.
